from_node.description: A biological system with organismal, symbiotic, metabolic and lineage structures.

to_node.description: The system counts as one biological individual under a specified criterion and scale.

bridge.statement: Physiological and evolutionary individuality can select different but structured units; the chosen unit must be indexed to explanandum and criterion.

scale_check.bridge_burden: Do not promote one biological criterion to all kinds/levels of individuality.

ind4.candidate_unit: system indexed to physiological or evolutionary individuality
ind4.integration_mechanism: metabolic/control integration or Darwinian lineage/fitness alignment depending on explanandum
ind4.nesting: nested biological individuals may be admissible
ind4.counterpartition: alternative partition by physiological versus evolutionary criterion
ind4.discriminator: metabolic cohesion, reproduction/lineage, fitness alignment, immune/control dynamics
ind4.revision_trigger: A case where the candidate partition loses explanatory advantage over its counterpartition.
